item.title: New €10,000 deductible for border workers from Casalzuigno
item.description: The New Frontier Agreement in force since 2024 introduces a deductible of €10,000 for new residents in Italy working in Ticino.
item.content:encoded:
## In breve - Nuovo Accordo Frontalieri in vigore dal 1° gennaio 2024 - Franchigia esenzione nuovi frontalieri: 10.000 euro - Convenzione doppie imposizioni firmata il 9 dicembre 1976 - La Svizzera non è membro dell'UE o dello SEE
## Fatti chiave - **Cosa**: Entrata in vigore del Nuovo Accordo Frontalieri - Quando: 1° gennaio 2024 - Dove: Confine Ticino-Italia (Casalzuigno/Mendrisio) - Chi: Governi italiano e svizzero - Importo: Franchigia 10.000 euro per nuovi frontalieri
Il 23 dicembre 2020 è stata la data in cui i governi italiano e svizzero hanno firmato il nuovo Accordo Frontalieri, un testo normativo che ha ridefinito le regole fiscali per chi vive in Italia e lavora in Ticino. Questo accordo, che ha richiesto anni di negoziati, è ufficialmente in vigore dal 1° gennaio 2024, segnando una svolta per i residenti di comuni come Casalzuigno. La ratifica italiana è avvenuta con la Legge 83 del 13 giugno 2023, mentre la base giuridica risale alla Convenzione sulle doppie imposizioni firmata il 9 dicembre 1976. È fondamentale chiarire che la Svizzera non fa parte dell'Unione Europea né dello Spazio Economico Europeo, un dettaglio che incide sulle procedure burocratiche e sui diritti di residenza per chi cerca di stabilirsi nel cantone senza lavorare.
### La separazione fiscale tra i due Paesi Il meccanismo fiscale per i frontalieri si basa su una netta distinzione tra la trattenuta alla fonte e le imposte dirette. La trattenuta alla fonte sul reddito da lavoro è operata esclusivamente in Svizzera: il datore di lavoro svizzero detrae l'imposta direttamente dalla busta paga. L'Italia, dal canto suo, evita la doppia imposizione attraverso il credito d'imposta, che viene inserito nel quadro CE della dichiarazione dei redditi, il famoso 730. Questo significa che l'imposta versata in Svizzera viene rivalutata in Italia, evitando che lo stesso reddito venga tassato due volte in piena misura.
Per chi vive a Casalzuigno, vicino al confine con Mendrisio, le implicazioni sono dirette. La geografia del confine ticinese, con valichi come Brogeda, facilita il pendolarismo quotidiano. Tuttavia, le regole fiscali non conoscono la distanza chilometrica: contano la residenza e il luogo di lavoro. I vecchi frontalieri, ovvero coloro che già operavano in questo regime prima del 17 luglio 2023, godono di un regime transitorio che si estende fino al 2033, mantenendo un'esenzione di 7.500 euro. I nuovi frontalieri, invece, rientrano nella disciplina del nuovo accordo con una franchigia di 10.000 euro. Questa distinzione temporale crea due classi di contribuenti con obblighi e vantaggi diversi, un aspetto che chi si trasferisce oggi da Casalzuigno deve considerare con attenzione prima di firmare un contratto di lavoro in Ticino. ### The practical impact of the tax exemption The difference between the 7,500 euro exemption for old cross-border commuters and the 10,000 euro exemption for new ones is not just a number on a form. Represents the minimum tax base that is not taxed. For a Casalzuigno resident starting a business in Ticino from 2024, the higher deductible means that a larger part of the net income will be exempt from Italian tax. This mechanism, defined by the New Frontier Agreement, aims to make the Ticino labour market more competitive for those residing in Italy. The Convention of 9 December 1976 remains the legal basis, but the 2020 agreement updates its operational clauses.
Tax management requires precise knowledge of the entities involved. The federal and cantonal rates, as well as the tax at source, are established by specific laws and administered by the AFC/ESTV at the federal level and by the cantonal tax administrations. It is not the task of the UFAS, which deals with social security like the AVS and AI, nor of the BFS, which deals with statistics, to set these rates. Many border workers make the mistake of confusing the roles of these entities, going to ask the wrong entity for tax information. For those who live in Casalzuigno, the proximity to the border makes commuting sustainable, but the tax complexity requires relying on official channels to avoid compilation errors.
###
## Useful tools for your case To verify your within/over 20 km tax scenario, use the [net salary calculator](nav:calculator) and the [tax return guide](nav:tax-return). ### Operational procedure for the transfer For those who decide to move to Casalzuigno and work in Ticino, the procedure starts with verifying residency. It is necessary to ensure that the purchase or lease deed complies with local regulations and that the civil‑registry residence is up‑to‑date. The next step is the request for Permit G, the document that authorizes cross‑border work. This permit is issued by the competent Swiss authority, often in coordination with the Italian authorities. It is important to submit the application early, as processing times may vary. The required documentation includes the employment contract, proof of residence in Casalzuigno and identity documents.
Once Permit G is obtained, tax management becomes automatic regarding withholding tax, but the filing of the income‑tax return in Italy remains the responsibility. The tax credit must be entered in the CE section of the 730 form. Those living in Casalzuigno must keep all Swiss pay slips to verify that the withholdings correspond to the applicable rates. In case of discrepancies, they can report them to the AFC/ESTV or to the cantonal tax services. It is not advisable to rely on approximate calculations for the return; it is better to use reliable calculation tools to estimate the net amount and the taxes due.
### Tools and resources for the cross‑border worker To evaluate the opportunity of moving, it is useful to compare the cost of living between the two countries. The cost of housing, utilities and services in Casalzuigno can be significantly lower than in Ticino. However, commuting expenses such as fuel or public‑transport tickets must be added to the budget. For those uncertain about the economic convenience, a CHF/EUR exchange‑rate comparator can help estimate real purchasing power. Moreover, for those who wish to simulate their net salary after Swiss withholdings and Italian tax, the tax calculator is the most effective tool. This tool allows entering contract parameters and obtaining a detailed estimate of the monthly net.
Choosing to live in Casalzuigno and work in Ticino is a multi‑year decision that requires analysis. Advantages include the higher salary and the quality of Swiss public services, while disadvantages may involve travel time and bureaucratic complexity. To maintain constant control over one’s fiscal and social‑security situation, it is essential to regularly update personal information. item.title: Smart Valley campus for businesses inaugurated in Daverio
item.description: The Smart Valley campus was inaugurated at Daverio, a space of five thousand square meters for specialized training and the connection between young people and companies.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Smart Valley campus inaugurated in Daverio - Total investment of four and a half million - Minister Giancarlo Giorgetti in attendance
## Key facts - **What**: Inauguration of the Smart Valley campus - When: This morning, with completion scheduled by the end of 2027 - Where: Via Roma industrial area in Daverio - Who: Ergo Foundation, Cariplo Foundation, and Lombardy Region - Amount: Three million from the 2024 Major Emblematic Projects call
A space designed to connect worlds that still too often struggle to communicate with one another, yet desperately need each other: businesses, with the skills they seek and the transformations they are facing, and the new generations, who must be able to get to know these realities, prepare themselves, and envision their future here. The Smart Valley stems from this vision and today marks the official inauguration of the campus spanning over five thousand square meters, located in the industrial area of via Roma in Daverio. The facility includes nine classrooms, advanced ergonomics and computer science laboratories, a Digital Model Factory, a 250-seat auditorium, and an event area.
### Facility details and institutional presence Minister of Economy Giancarlo Giorgetti took part in the inaugural ceremony. The redevelopment of the area and the creation of the campus are supported by the 2024 Major Emblematic Projects call with a contribution of three million euros, of which two were allocated by the Cariplo Foundation and one by the Lombardy Region. The overall project, presented from the stage by the president of the Ergo Foundation, reaches a value of four and a half million euros, leaving one and a half million still to be raised locally. The completion timeline for the construction and training works is set by the end of 2027. The development path of the industrial area of Via Roma in Daverio began in 2024. Subsequently, in 2025, the Digital Model Factory was opened, a space specifically designed to promote innovation and follow the evolution of industrial production processes. With today, the offer expands to welcome people who will directly experience this technological and productive transition, offering containers of skills and open laboratories equipped with advanced demonstration stations compared to traditional school classrooms.
### Specialist training and collaboration with companies Training activities within the campus will start at the end of September with the start of the first IFTS course in Management Mechatronics. This training program has been structured in close collaboration with its Lombardia Meccatronica Academy and with local companies. Inside the structure there will also be space for the Startup Garage, an initiative developed in synergy with SUPSI to offer girls and boys the opportunity to experiment concretely and encourage the growth of their innovative ideas.

The programming of activities within the Daverio campus foresees the imminent start of courses and workshops dedicated to young people and companies. Today's inauguration marks the operational step for the structure, which joins the advanced technological laboratories and the Digital Model Factory with the new training courses scheduled for the coming months. Meanwhile, the local companies and the entities involved continue to collect the remaining portion of the funds necessary to complete the entire economic project, estimated at four and a half million in total.
### Skills development and future collaborations The involvement of academic and training institutions such as SUPSI and its Lombardia Meccatronica Academy outlines the perimeter of the activities that will animate the auditorium spaces and the nine specialized classrooms. The programming provides for the direct involvement of the new generations in ergonomics, computer science and management mechatronics laboratories, with the aim of responding to the real needs of competence expressed by the local industrial fabric through targeted paths and open laboratories.

item.title: Stadler Rail focuses on Kazakhstan: 53 million investments
item.description: The Turgovian manufacturer Stadler Rail invests 25 million francs in the Astana plant to start the production of aluminium crates.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Stadler Rail invests 25 million francs in the Astana plant - Another 100 jobs created and new production in Astana - Total investment of at least 53 million francs between 2023 and 2031
## Key facts - **What**: Investment for railway plant and aluminum carbody production - When: Period from 2023 to 2031 - Where: Astana, Kazakhstan - Who: Stadler Rail, Thurgau-based railway manufacturer - Amount: 25 million francs in immediate investment, 53 million total
The Thurgau-based railway manufacturer Stadler Rail has announced an investment of 25 million francs directly allocated to its plant located in Astana. This large-scale industrial operation allows for the creation of another 100 local jobs and gives rise to the first highly automated production of aluminum carbodies for railway vehicles in the entire Central Asia region. The official announcement was issued through a press release released today by the company itself, highlighting the strategic scope of the overseas production expansion project. Inside the Kazakh production site, new workshops are planned specifically dedicated to the welding and painting of various structural elements of the trains. Currently, the industrial structure employs about 650 people in the territory of Kazakhstan. Local specialists are trained directly for the new complex tasks at Stadler Rail's operational headquarters located in Europe, thus guaranteeing a high quality and technological standard.
### Operations and production lines in Astana The Astana plant already plays a central role today, handling numerous phases of train production. Among other things, railway carbodies, dedicated electrical equipment, undercarriage components and bogies are manufactured at this site, alongside the assembly and commissioning activities of the railway vehicles. With this new expansion phase, Stadler Rail's stated objective is to significantly increase local added value. Overall, the industrial group aims to invest at least 53 million francs in Kazakhstan in the period between 2023 and 2031, further consolidating its international production presence in a key market for the supply of advanced rolling stock meeting the needs of local and foreign customers. The announcement of the new investments made by the Thurgau-based group found an immediate response also on international financial markets and stock exchanges. On the stock market, the Stadler Rail share recorded a gain of almost 3%, settling at around 29 francs per single share. Analyzing the financial trend of the stock on the stock market, it is observed that since the beginning of January the price has risen by 35%, while over the previous twelve months the overall calculated increase stands at 41%. However, it should be remembered that at the time of its initial stock market landing in April 2019, the stock was traded at a value of 43 francs, highlighting the historical fluctuations that have characterized the stock market journey of the Thurgau company over the years.
### Historical origins and industrial profile of the group To fully understand the current structure of the company, it is useful to retrace its industrial roots. Stadler Rail traces its historical origins back to the engineering firm founded by Ernst Stadler in 1942 in Zurich. Today the company has its main headquarters located in Bussnang, in the canton of Thurgau (TG). The enterprise is engaged in the manufacture of a wide range of rolling stock ranging from high-speed trains to regional convoys, including trams and vehicles destined for underground systems. These are modern vehicles that also circulate regularly on Swiss and Ticino railway lines. The industrial group has a total of 18'000 employees distributed globally, of which about 6'000 units work directly in Switzerland. Regarding financial data relating to business volume, in 2025 the company achieved a total turnover of 3.7 billion francs, confirming its economic solidity and strategic relevance within the Swiss manufacturing and metalworking sector.

The international growth of industrial groups with Swiss roots such as Stadler Rail demonstrates the strong global vocation of Swiss manufacturing companies, capable of combining the historical engineering tradition with highly automated production plants in emerging markets such as Central Asia. The expansion in Astana, with the inclusion of new professionals and specialist technical training in Europe, highlights how industrial competitiveness is based on long-term targeted investments. The group's financial planning, which foresees total resources of at least CHF 53 million between 2023 and 2031, testifies to a strategic vision aimed at increasing local added value and optimising construction processes for rolling stock destined for international rail networks.
### Monitoring of markets and future prospects The stock market performance of Stadler Rail reflects the response of investors to the company's production expansion strategies and economic results, including turnover of CHF 3.7 billion in 2025 and the 18,000 total employees, one third of whom are active in Swiss factories. The management of production sites distributed between the headquarters in Bussnang (TG) and foreign hubs such as Kazakhstan requires complex logistical and engineering coordination, rooted in the tradition of the studio founded in Zurich in 1942.

item.title: Verbania, works on the San Giovanni bridge: modified traffic
item.description: Night-time interventions by Acqua Novara.VCO on the San Giovanni bridge at Verbania from 14 to 18 September with one-way alternation.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Water network intervention in Verbania - Construction site active from September 14 to 18 - Nighttime schedule from 22:00 to 06:00 - Alternating one-way traffic with traffic light system
## Key facts - **What**: Replacement of a section of the water network - When: From September 14 to 18 - Where: Bridge over the San Giovanni stream, Canottieri Intra area - Who: Acqua Novara.VCO
Extraordinary maintenance work on the water network in the municipal area of Verbania will begin in the coming hours, with direct impacts on local traffic and road connections frequently used by those moving in the area for work or personal reasons. The intervention has been planned by Acqua Novara.VCO and will specifically affect the area located near Canottieri Intra, a crucial point for urban circulation and transit flows affecting the lower Verbano area and connections towards the border and main routes.
### Details of the water intervention The schedule provides for the targeted replacement of a section of the local water network considered strategic for the proper functioning of underground infrastructure. To minimize disruption to vehicle and resident traffic, the operator has decided to concentrate the work exclusively during nighttime hours. The construction site will remain operational from September 14 to 18, covering a timeframe of five consecutive days during which the technical team will be engaged in excavations and laying new pipes. The choice of nighttime hours responds to the need to safeguard daytime traffic, reducing the congestion that usually characterizes peak hours in this area of Intra. Analyzing the operational management of the construction site, it is clear how the planning has been designed to ensure the continuity of the vehicular passage even in the presence of significant technical limitations. The changes to the roads on the bridge over the San Giovanni stream will come into force every day from 22:00, extending until the first light of dawn, precisely until 06:00 the next morning. This time interval of six hours for each night will allow the operators to proceed with the excavations and the replacement of the pipelines in total safety.
### Traffic and traffic impacts During the entire duration of the night works, the transit of the vehicles will never be completely interrupted, thus guaranteeing the passage through the San Giovanni bridge. However, in order to allow construction operations to take place in the Canottieri Intra area, traffic will be regulated through the establishment of an alternating one-way route managed directly by a temporary traffic light system. This solution will require special attention from drivers in transit at night, who will have to take into account short waits near the construction site traffic light. Check the connections and roads in the area to better plan your movements and monitor any slowdowns caused by road construction sites.

To better deal with the temporary changes to road traffic planned in Verbania, it is advisable to take some logistical precautions, especially for those who travel in the evening and at night along the bridge over the San Giovanni stream. Those who usually travel between 22:00 and 06:00 from 14 to 18 September in the Canottieri Intra area should consider the presence of the traffic light system and the consequent alternating one-way traffic, calculating slightly higher time margins for their travels on the road.
### How to move around during work Before traveling, it is advisable to check the traffic status and consider alternative routes if you have to comply with particularly strict road maps. item.description: Sergio Savoia's political candidacy for the Avanti con Ticino e Lavoro list in Lugano generates online debate, controversy and clarification.
item.content:encoded:
## In a nutshell - Nomination of Sergio Savoia for Forward with Ticino&Lavoro - Reactions on social media and controversy with haters - Clarification on the definition of pensioner
## Key facts - **What**: Political candidacy and responses to criticism - When: September 2026 - Where: Lugano and Canton Ticino - Who: Sergio Savoia
The recent candidacy of Sergio Savoia for the list Avanti con Ticino&Lavoro has generated several public reactions and online comments, leading the protagonist to clarify his position regarding the criticism received and the terms used to describe him. The announcement of the descent into the political field triggered a series of reactions from users on social media, a phenomenon that prompted Savoy to intervene publicly to define the boundaries between normal political confrontation and exploitation. At the center of the discussion are the controversies raised by the haters who appeared following the news of the candidacy, a topic that according to the new candidate is often misrepresented for the sake of visibility. The discussion focused on how candidates manage their presence on digital platforms and the perception of online dissent.
### Managing the digital community
In the debate around his figure, Savoy wanted to mark a clear distance from the role of victim, emphasizing that harsh criticism is part of the public path and should not be dramatized. Il confronto sulle piattaforme digitali apre a una riflessione più ampia sulle dinamiche che caratterizzano il dibattito pubblico e la comunicazione politica moderna. Spesso i commenti negativi online non riflettono l'effettivo orientamento della maggioranza silenziosa che legge i contenuti senza intervenire, ma sono guidati da tendenze comportamentali che favoriscono le reazioni di segno negativo. Questa distorsione percettiva può alterare la reale portata delle critiche ricevute dai candidati durante le campagne elettorali. L'analisi delle reazioni digitali evidenzia come il confine tra la critica legittima e il comportamento penalmente rilevante debba essere tracciato con precisione. Mentre le opinioni dure e il dissenso fanno parte del confronto democratico, minacce o comportamenti assimilabili allo stalking richiedono un intervento tempestivo e il ricorso alle autorità competenti, una linea d'azione già intrapresa in passato di fronte a episodi particolarmente gravi.
### Il ruolo del vittimismo nella comunicazione
Un altro aspetto centrale sollevato nel dibattito riguarda l'utilizzo strategico del vittimismo nella comunicazione politica contemporanea. Trasformare il normale dissenso o qualche insulto isolato in una narrazione incentrata sulla propria condizione di vittima viene definito un atteggiamento stucchevole, sebbene potenzialmente efficace in termini di consenso elettorale. Questa tendenza a spettacolarizzare le tensioni online rischia di svuotare di significato il confronto sui temi reali. Nel caso specifico, la scelta di campo di Savoia punta a rifiutare questo tipo di narrazione, privilegiando un approccio basato sulla consapevolezza del proprio ruolo pubblico e sulla capacità di sostenere il confronto politico senza ricorrere a espedienti retorici. La discussione si inserisce nel contesto più ampio delle permessi e delle dinamiche istituzionali che interessano il territorio cantonale, dove la trasparenza e la comunicazione diretta con i cittadini rappresentano elementi chiave per il consenso.

item.description: The 5000 sqm campus dedicated to training and innovation is open at Daverio. Investment of 4.5 million euros to bridge the gap between school and factory.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - SMARTT VAlley's Education Area inaugurated in Daverio. - A campus spanning over 5,000 square meters dedicated to skills and innovation. - First IFTS course starting at the end of September with fifteen students and companies. - Total investment of 4.5 million euros for the project.
## Key facts - **What**: Inauguration of the SMARTT VAlley campus - When: Saturday morning - Where: Via Roma 57, Daverio - Who: Fondazione Ergo - Amount: 3 million euros from public grants, 1.5 million to be raised - Capacity: 9 classrooms, 250-seat auditorium
The SMARTT VAlley Education Area has officially opened its doors at Via Roma 57 in Daverio, marking a significant moment for the local industrial fabric. The facility, which extends over five thousand square meters within a completely redeveloped industrial warehouse, aims to create a concrete bridge between the world of education and the business sector. The inauguration, held in the presence of local authorities, regional representatives, and the Minister of Economy Giancarlo Giorgetti, highlighted the importance of investing in advanced skills to counter the deindustrialization of the Varese area.
### A cutting-edge facility for training The campus is designed as a physical ecosystem where didactics meet practical application in ergonomics, computer science, and a Digital Model Factory. Notable features include a 250-seat auditorium, event zones, sports areas, and a bistro, all designed to foster interaction between different generations and professional backgrounds. The General Director of Fondazione Ergo and SMARTT VAlley, Rachele Sessa, emphasized how the space, which less than a year ago was only a project on paper, is now fully operational. The primary goal is to align the needs of companies, which require updated skills to face the digital transition and artificial intelligence, with the educational paths of young people, who are often uncertain about the skills required by the current market. The first IFTS course in Management Mechatronics, developed in collaboration with ITS Lombardia Meccatronica Academy, will start at the end of September, involving fifteen students in apprenticeships at as many local companies, marking a first concrete step toward the new 'Made in Italy'. The SMARTT VAlley initiative raises crucial reflections for the cross-border labor market, where the demand for high-level technical skills is a constant theme for workers commuting daily to the Canton of Ticino. The model proposed by Gabriele Caragnano, based on sharing spaces and expertise among multiple companies rather than isolated internal academies, offers an interesting point of analysis for companies operating in a context of intense global competition. For a cross-border worker, understanding the evolution of Italian factories is fundamental: the gap between the perception of the factory as a place of toil and today's reality, characterized by technology and innovation, is a divide the project intends to bridge. The ability to adapt to professions that do not yet exist, by training systemic and creative thinking, represents a common challenge for both the Italian and Swiss industrial systems.
### Skills analysis in the cross-border context The cross-pollination between different educational levels — from Startup Garage students to IFTS participants — suggests a dynamic approach to continuous learning. At a time when companies in Ticino and Varese are facing the need to digitize processes, the availability of professionals capable of applying Olivetti's theories of 'know-how' in high-tech contexts becomes a competitive advantage. The risk of deindustrialization mentioned during the inauguration is a warning signal that concerns the entire territory. Cross-border workers, who bring their wealth of skills across the [Brogeda](nav:border) border crossing, often find themselves acting as a bridge between different corporate cultures. Basic professional training and specific training in mechatronics manage a labor demand that knows no borders. The commitment to an ecosystem based on territorial collaboration, as promoted by SMARTT VAlley, could facilitate greater harmonization of the technical skills required on both sides of the border, improving professional mobility and the quality of profiles choosing to operate in the manufacturing or technological sector, regardless of the nationality of the workplace.

## In brief - Open day at the plant on September 19 - Mandatory reservations via the Eventbrite platform - District heating plant active in Varese since 1992
## Key facts - **What**: Extraordinary opening of the district heating plant - When: Saturday, September 19 from 9 am all day long - Where: Plant at via Ottorino Rossi 19 in Varese - Who: Gruppo Acinque and Acinque Tecnologie - Amount: 63 GWh of thermal energy delivered in 2025 - Capacity: Network of 16 kilometers serving about 12,000 equivalent apartments
The appointment with Impianti Aperti returns to the province of Varese, the series of free guided tours to the facilities of the Acinque Group which takes place throughout the year across all territories served by the multi-utility and which in the last edition involved about 700 citizens. On Saturday, September 19, starting from 9 am all day long, the doors of the Varese district heating plant, located at via Ottorino Rossi 19, will open. This is the beating heart of the network that runs through the capital city, an energy system active in the city since 1992. To participate in the tour, reservations are required via the Eventbrite.it platform. The initiative allows citizens to get a close-up look at the technological and professional heritage of the group.
### Objectives of the Open Plants initiative Acinque's choice to annually open a selection of its plants has a dual purpose. On the one hand, it aims to raise citizens' awareness on energy issues and the value of natural resources to promote their conscious use. On the other hand, it aims to showcase the technological and professional heritage of the group that daily creates economic spillover effects for the local territories. The Varese event represents the first stop of this visiting program which continues in other locations in Lombardy in the following weeks, offering all interested parties the opportunity to discover the inner workings of large local energy infrastructures and to understand the industrial production processes managed by the multi-utility in the provincial and regional territory. The Varese district heating system boasts a history of over thirty years, having been operational in the city for more than three decades. The plant supplies heat to over 150 users, which include not only residential condominiums but also commercial businesses, industrial activities, and public buildings located in the south-east area of Varese. Among the main beneficiaries of this energy service are the University of Insubria campus, the Fondazione Molina, the Municipality, and the Varese hospital. The distribution network, entirely managed by Acinque Tecnologie, branches out into the urban fabric for a total length of 16 kilometers, guaranteeing thermal coverage for approximately 12,000 equivalent apartments distributed throughout the city area.
### Integration with renewable sources and cogeneration The Varese system is powered by heat produced by the cogeneration plant in Via Ottorino Rossi 19. Through cogeneration engines, the plant is able to produce electricity and simultaneously recover the thermal energy released during the thermodynamic process. This combined production allows for a significant reduction in fuel for power supply, achieved by recovering energy that would otherwise be dispersed into the atmosphere as waste. Thanks to this cogeneration process, during 2025 the plant supplied 63 GWh of thermal energy.
A distinctive peculiarity of the Varese system lies in the presence of a solar thermal plant that integrates the heat production of the plant by exploiting a renewable source such as the sun. Solar thermal panels can produce 450 MWh of thermal energy in a year, exactly equal to the domestic hot water requirement of 150 apartments. This contribution makes it possible to avoid the use of fossil fuels for 43 toe and prevents the emission of 108 tons of CO2 into the atmosphere every year.

item.title: Speedaf in Switzerland: 50,000 packages per day
item.description: Speedaf, a Swiss subsidiary founded in April, aims to handle up to 50,000 shipments per day with centres in Zurich, Bern and Lausanne and headquarters in Freiburg.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Speedaf lands in Switzerland to compete with Posta, Planzer, DPD and DHL. - The Chinese group aims to handle up to 50,000 shipments per day. - Swiss subsidiary founded in April and already operational, headquartered in Fribourg. - 60% is Posta's market share in the parcel sector in 2025.
## Key facts - **What**: Entry of Chinese logistics giant Speedaf into the Swiss parcel market. - When: Subsidiary founded last April, operational within one or two years. - Where: Legal headquarters in Fribourg, distribution centres planned in Zurich, Bern and Lausanne. - Who: Speedaf, with the support of founding shareholders including ZTO Express. - Amount: Internal model estimated at 1.80 francs per parcel, with a profit threshold of 1.20 francs.
Competition looming in Switzerland for Posta and other established carriers such as Planzer, DPD and DHL: Chinese logistics giant Speedaf is building a network across the country. It could capture a market share quickly, within one or two years. The group, already active in over thirty countries across Asia, the Middle East and Africa, wants to open a sorting centre to manage a volume of up to 50,000 shipments per day and regional distribution centres in Zurich, Bern and Lausanne. Speedaf's Swiss subsidiary was founded only in April and is already operational, having indicated a staff representative to the Awp agency. Parcels with the conspicuous orange brand are already visible in front of house doors. Considerable quantities are already being moved, the source says, without providing concrete figures. The company has its legal headquarters in Fribourg and is recruiting staff. The central sorting centre should cover about 4,000 square metres, while the regional distribution centres should each measure about 500 square metres. For the larger structure, according to rumours Speedaf has set its sights on the Härkingen region (SO), where Posta already operates. In the delivery area the group wants to build a network that also relies on fleet operators and independent partners. The goal is a capillary last‑mile delivery. The company apparently aims to win over Swiss online retailers, brick‑and‑mortar traders, as well as small and medium‑sized enterprises, thereby directly impacting the business of established operators. Speedaf arrives in the Confederation with an important advantage: access to large volumes of parcels from Chinese e‑commerce. The group, founded in 2019, also has ties to a heavyweight of the Chinese sector: among its founding shareholders is ZTO Express, one of China’s largest parcel services. ZTO is likewise pushing its international activities: last April its air‑cargo division inaugurated the first freight link directly to Europe, linking Hong Kong to Budapest.
### Organisational and logistics structure
The expansion details outline a capillary strategy across Swiss territory. The creation of regional distribution centres in strategic hubs such as Zurich, Bern and Lausanne shows the intention to quickly cover the country’s main urban agglomerations. The recruitment drive is already underway and the choice of the Härkingen region in the canton of Solothurn for the central sorting hub of four thousand square metres mirrors the logistics map already exploited by historic competitors. The use of third‑party fleets and independent partners allows Speedaf to lighten initial fixed costs, aiming for a flexible network focused on final‑door delivery. Direct involvement of ZTO Express provides a significant financial and operational backbone internationally, capable of sustaining the initial market‑penetration phase in Switzerland. How much Speedaf is aggressively calculating for entry into the Swiss market is shown by an internal planning template posted on LinkedIn by a company manager. For a selected delivery area Speedaf is assumed to receive CHF 1.80 per parcel. The profit threshold is just under 1.20 francs. There would therefore be just over 60 cents of profit left per submission. These are numbers that raise the ears of the sector: the calculated profit threshold would be very low and rather unrealistic, says a representative of the branch in statements made to AWP. In his opinion, however, the new competitor should not be underestimated. Chinese competition needs to be taken seriously, especially if you look at what is currently happening in the European automotive industry. It is also remarkable that a foreign supplier with direct access to large quantities of shipments from China builds its own Swiss network. In this way, it is not excluded that Speedaf will grow rapidly: within one or two years the company could rise among the large suppliers of the Swiss parcel market. Decisive will be to see how much financial wind the company has. Success will also depend on the quality of delivery. The Post Office, as the dominant operator, carefully observes the new competitor, but is sure of itself. The company has successfully faced intense competition in the parcel market for many years, a spokesperson said.

item.title: Living in Pognana Lario and working in Ticino
item.description: Practical guide for border workers at Pognana Lario: journeys to Chiasso, taxes, tax agreement and budget management.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Pognana Lario is located on the eastern shore of the Como branch of Lake Como. - The journey to the Brogeda customs requires passing through Como. - New Agreement in force since January 1, 2024, with a €10,000 tax-free allowance.
## Key facts - **What**: Living on the lake and working as a cross-border worker in Canton Ticino - When: New Agreement valid from January 1, 2024 (Law 83 of 13/6/2023) - Where: Pognana Lario, Province of Como and border crossings towards Chiasso - Who: Cross-border workers with a G permit residing in the border zone - Amount: Tax-free allowance for new cross-border workers at €10,000; exemption for old ones at €7,500
Pognana Lario is situated along the Larian provincial road between Como and Bellagio, offering an open view of the lake and a quiet residential context. Those who choose to settle in this village to travel every working day to Canton Ticino must set their road itinerary by descending towards Como and then heading for the customs of Ponte Chiasso or the motorway at Brogeda. Travel times depend heavily on morning traffic conditions along the coastal road and in crossing the provincial capital before reaching Switzerland.
### Road system and connections to the border To reach the main work destinations in Mendrisiotto or Lugano, the classic itinerary involves leaving Pognana Lario on the SP 583 towards Como. Once past the city, the route continues towards the Brogeda crossing for the A2 motorway junction or through the city customs. During peak hours, the main bottleneck is represented by the access points to Como, where the vehicle flow from the lakeshore converges. Monitoring customs crossing times via updates on [border waiting times](nav:border) is useful for planning early morning departures and avoiding significant delays at the border. Choosing Pognana Lario offers advantages in terms of tranquility and panoramic views, but requires careful evaluation of the daily commute. Compared to other municipalities in the Como belt, real estate costs for purchasing or renting can be more affordable for an equivalent surface area and panoramic view, partly offsetting road transport expenses.
### Fiscal framework between Switzerland and Italy On the tax and social security front, G-permit workers must distinguish their status based on their date of hire. The New Cross-Border Agreement, signed on 23 December 2020 and entered into force on 1 January 2024 following its ratification with Law 83 of 13 June 2023, governs the treatment between the two States, integrating the historic Double Taxation Agreement of 9 December 1976. Withholding tax on employment income is levied only in Switzerland by the cantonal administration and the FTA/ESTV. In Italy, no double taxation occurs because the foreign tax credit is applied in section CE of the tax return. For those who entered the Swiss market before 17 July 2023, the transitional regime applies until 2033 with an exemption of €7,500, in addition to the tax refunds distributed to border municipalities. For new cross-border commuters hired after that date, an allowance of €10,000 applies to total income, followed by progressive taxation under IRPEF brackets (23% up to €28,000, 35% between €28,001 and €50,000, 43% above €50,000). To assess the impact on net disposable income and compare housing costs, it is advisable to examine the differences with an estimate of the cross-border [cost of living](nav:cost-of-living).
## Useful tools for your case To verify your within/over 20 km tax scenario, use the [net salary calculator](nav:calculator) and the [tax return guide](nav:tax-return). Those planning the transfer to Pognana Lario must carefully prepare the bureaucratic steps. The first step is to change residence at the municipal registry, promptly communicating the new territorial location to the Swiss employer for the updating of the G permit. From the point of view of Swiss social security, the paycheck includes the mandatory deductions: AVS/AI/IPG equal to 5.3% borne by the worker, AD/AC unemployment insurance at 1.1% up to the maximum of CHF 148'200, LAINF accident coverage between 0.7% and 1.5% and the second LPP pillar with scalar rates from 7% to 18% based on the age group from 25 years.
### Health and tax obligations In the health sector, border workers can make use of the right of option between the Swiss health insurance fund LAMal (with deductibles for adults between CHF 300 and CHF 2500) and the Italian health system. Annually, taxpayers required to submit the 730 or the Income form must complete the appropriate sections to calculate the personal income tax net of the sums withdrawn as tax at source, indicating the deductions due and the Swiss social security payments. item.title: New tank in Stabio: water for the Mendrisiotto
item.description: The new 4 million franc water system for security of supply in Mendrisiotto was inaugurated in Bella Cima.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - New water supply system inaugurated in Bella Cima - Project cost approximately 4 million francs - Total capacity of over 3,000 cubic meters - Regional strategy for water security
## Key facts - **What**: New Bella Cima water reservoir - When: Late summer, during a period marked by high temperatures - Where: Stabio, Canton Ticino - Who: Municipality of Stabio and Mendrisiotto Regional Aqueduct Consortium - Amount: Approximately 4 million francs - Capacity: Over 3,000 cubic meters divided into two new tanks
The new facility inaugurated in Bella Cima represents another piece in the deep reorganization of the water network in the region, while the completion of the long-awaited lake aqueduct also approaches. This inauguration comes at the end of a summer once again marked by high temperatures and a scarcity of precipitation. This is only an apparent coincidence: droughts and prolonged heatwaves are in fact making the issue of water supply security increasingly central. In Stabio, this journey began some time ago. In recent years, the Municipality has invested in the Santa Margherita abstraction well, the underground source from which the water distributed across the municipal territory is drawn. The objective, explained Mayor Simone Castelletti, is to look beyond the immediate needs of the individual municipality and build a system capable of guaranteeing greater security also at a regional level. The new Bella Cima reservoir moves precisely in this direction. The project, which cost around 4 million francs, will not only serve Stabio but is part of a broader supply security strategy for the entire Mendrisiotto region. There are two new tanks, with a total capacity of over 3,000 cubic meters of water. About half will represent the reserve necessary for the normal operation of the network, while the other half will be available to cope with emergencies. The water comes from the Santa Margherita well. As explained by Stefano Quarenghi, director of AMS - Azienda Comunale di Stabio, this is an underground water abstraction well located in the Stabio plain. The water is pumped simultaneously toward the municipal network and the reservoir; when the pumps are not running, gravity will allow the water accumulated in Bella Cima to reach the population.
### The regional strategy
However, the significance of the project goes beyond municipal borders. Water knows no borders, recalled Marco Romano, president of the Consortium Delegation of the Mendrisiotto Regional Aqueduct Consortium, emphasizing how the strategy is now to connect the various sources available in the district. The decisive step for the territory will be the entry into operation of the Riva San Vitale pumping and water treatment plant, a project that has been discussed for about 50 years. According to Marco Romano, the station is expected to be delivered by the end of the year and become operational during 2027. From that moment on, the Mendrisiotto region will also be able to rely on lake water, guaranteeing municipalities greater complementarity of sources. Whenever a municipal resource experiences difficulties, lake water can step in to support the network; other municipalities that can no longer use their own sources will instead be able to fully benefit from lake supply. This infrastructural evolution is part of a geographical and climatic context that directly involves the entire cross-border area of Canton Ticino, where the management of natural resources and primary services requires a regional vision and targeted investments.
### The management of water resources
Greater availability, however, does not mean letting our guard down regarding consumption. Mayor Simone Castelletti recalled that Stabio can count on the precious resource of the Santa Margherita well, but the very last few years have shown how necessary it is to use it carefully. Therefore, even with new reservoirs and new sources, the appeal to the population to avoid waste remains valid. Because water, as the mayor summarized, remains the blue gold of the territory. The planning and constant maintenance of distribution networks represent fundamental pillars to guarantee the continuity of essential services throughout the district, connecting traditional underground reserves with the future opportunities offered by lake abstraction.

item.title: Stabio-Gaggiolo speed bump: queues and anger from cross-border workers
item.description: Reports about the speed bump just beyond Gaggiolo customs describe more than ten extra minutes every day. Official counts show a crossing already under pressure.
item.content:encoded:
## The pinch point just beyond customs
Our newsroom has been collecting reports from cross-border workers travelling through Gaggiolo towards Stabio. The point they identify is the speed bump immediately beyond the crossing: during peak periods, the slowing effect adds to checks and merging traffic, turning a few seconds lost by each car into a queue that spreads along the road.
According to the reports shared by drivers, the journey now takes more than 10 minutes longer than usual. Queues are said to start around 05:00 on weekdays, and the problem is also reported on public holidays. These are local reports, not certified measurements: without a before-and-after comparison, we cannot attribute the entire phenomenon to the bump alone.
The anger among cross-border workers is understandable. People leaving before daylight to arrive at work on time see their safety margin disappear every morning; those crossing on holidays face the same bottleneck. Residents are affected too, as recurring queues bring noise, braking and diversions onto nearby roads. ## The figures confirm that the crossing is under pressure
The official 2025 count by the Osservatorio Ambientale della Svizzera Italiana at station N24 Stabio-Gaggiolo records 1,083 vehicles per hour between 05:00 and 06:00 on weekdays and 1,152 between 06:00 and 07:00. The daily average reaches 18,991 vehicles on weekdays, 15,836 on Saturday and 12,489 on Sunday. The figures do not prove that the speed bump causes the queues, but they show why a capacity reduction at a sensitive point could become visible very early in the day.
Corriere del Ticino described via Gaggiolo as one of the most congested routes and reported flows of around 1,000–1,100 vehicles per hour between 05:00 and 20:00. The public discussion is not starting from zero: the Municipality of Stabio has called traffic on via Gaggiolo and via Cantonale unsatisfactory, linking it to safety and liveability, while a local petition in 2015 collected around 1,200 requests for safer crossings.
The choice is not between safety and flow. It is about checking whether the current solution is proportionate to the real traffic and whether alternatives — a lower bump, a different geometry or effective signs — can protect pedestrians and residents without adding ten minutes to thousands of journeys every day. ## The request: public data and a proportionate solution
We ask the competent authorities to publish the technical reason, installation date and speed limits associated with the bump. We also ask for comparable measurements of journey times and queues before and after the intervention, on weekdays and public holidays. Only then can it be decided whether the bump should be removed or lowered, or whether its configuration should change, without questioning road safety.
We have gathered public sources and explain how to sign on the [petition page](/en/stabio-speed-bump-petition/). To follow crossing conditions, see the [Gaggiolo waiting-time history](/en/cross-border-guide/border-waiting-times/gaggiolo/).
**Sources:** [OASI, N24 traffic count](https://www.oasi.ti.ch/web/rest/trafficcounts/sheet/051.pdf); [Corriere del Ticino, via Gaggiolo](https://www.cdt.ch/news/la-corsia-che-rendera-via-gaggiolo-piu-scorrevole-395441); [Municipality of Stabio, mobility and safety response](https://www.stabio.ch/fileadmin/user_upload/Documenti/CC/Interpellanze/2024/Risposta_a_interpellanza_GUS_e_I_Verdi_-__Criticita_del_progetto_di_potenziamento_dell_autostrada_N2_Lugano_e_Mendrisio__PoLuMe__-_Quater.pdf); [laRegione, Stabio petition and safety](https://www.laregione.ch/cantone/mendrisiotto/1186791/strada-per-il-gaggiolo-piu-sicura-a-stabio-cittadini-soddisfatti).

item.title: Gasoline in Switzerland: reserves open, effects on prices
item.description: Mandatory open stocks for petrol and diesel. From 8 to 20 September 2026 withdrawal up to 30,000 m³. Low-level Cressier and Reno refinery shutdown.
item.content:encoded:
## In a nutshell - Mandatory open stocks for petrol and diesel - From 8 to 20 September 2026 withdrawal up to 30,000 m³ - Low-level Cressier and Reno refinery shutdown - Less than 3% of total reserves, no alarm
## Key facts - **What**: Temporary withdrawal from mandatory gasoline and diesel stocks - When: from 8 to 20 September 2026 - Where: Switzerland, with effects on the Ticino market - Who: Federal Office for Economic Supply - Amount: up to 30,000 m³ of petrol and the same amount of diesel - Percentage: less than 3% of required reserves - Reason: Cressier refinery shutdown and difficulty on the Rhine
The Confederation has opened strategic fuel reserves. On September 8, 2026, the Federal Office for Economic Supply authorized the temporary withdrawal from mandatory gasoline and diesel stocks to support the market and ensure continuity of supply. The decision comes after the shutdown of the Cressier refinery, in the Canton of Neuchâtel, and the difficulties of transport on the Rhine.
For those who cross the border every day to work in Ticino, the news deserves attention. The withdrawal period runs from 8 to 20 September, with a maximum amount of 30,000 cubic metres of petrol and the same amount of diesel. According to the Confederation, this figure represents less than 3% of their respective mandatory stocks. No alert on availability, but the situation must be monitored.
### Because the ### Cosa cambia per chi attraversa il confine
Il frontaliere che ogni mattina parte dall'Italia verso il Ticino con il permesso G in tasca ha una variabile in più da considerare: il prezzo della benzina. La decisione della Confederazione non modifica le aliquote fiscali né tocca l'imposta alla fonte, ma incide su una voce di spesa quotidiana.
Consideriamo il quadro. La raffineria di Cressier copre poco più del 30% del fabbisogno nazionale. Il Reno, che è la via principale per i prodotti petroliferi, ha livelli d'acqua bassi. Le riserve strategiche ora sono parzialmente aperte. Cosa significa in pratica? Che per due settimane il mercato avrà una valvola di sfogo, ma i prezzi potrebbero comunque salire se la raffineria non riprende presto.
Per chi percorre 40-60 chilometri al giorno tra andata e ritorno, un aumento di 5-10 centesimi al litro può significare 15-25 franchi in più al mese. Non è una cifra enorme, ma si somma ad altre voci: l'AVS, la LPP, la LAMal. Il budget del frontaliere è fatto di tanti piccoli tasselli.
### Confronto con la situazione precedente
Prima del fermo di Cressier, il mercato era già sotto pressione per il Reno. Ora, con le riserve aperte, la disponibilità è garantita ma non illimitata. I 30.000 metri cubi di benzina e altrettanti di gasolio rappresentano meno del 3% delle scorte obbligatorie. Una goccia nel mare, ma sufficiente a evitare il panico.
Il periodo critico va dall'8 al 20 settembre. Dopo quella data, se la raffineria non avrà risolto il problema tecnico, la situazione potrebbe tornare tesa. I frontalieri che hanno la possibilità di fare rifornimento in Italia, dove i prezzi sono spesso più bassi, potrebbero valutare questa opzione. Ma attenzione: la convenienza dipende dal tasso di cambio CHF/EUR e dal tempo perso in coda ai valichi come Brogeda o Gaggiolo.
### Scenari possibili
Scenario uno: la raffineria riprende entro fine settembre, il Reno si rialza, i prezzi restano stabili. Scenario due: il fermo si prolunga, le riserve si esauriscono, i prezzi salgono. In entrambi i casi, il frontaliere deve essere pronto. Monitorare i prezzi, pianificare gli spostamenti, considerare il car pooling con colleghi che vivono nella stessa zona.
La decisione della Confederazione è un segnale di attenzione verso il mercato, ma non elimina l'incertezza. Per chi lavora in Canton Ticino, la benzina è un costo fisso. Conoscere la situazione attuale aiuta a prendere decisioni informate. E se i prezzi salgono, conviene verificare se il proprio datore di lavoro offre contributi per le spese di trasporto o se esistono agevolazioni per i pendolari.
## Useful tools for your case To verify your within/over 20 km tax scenario, use the [net salary calculator](nav:calculator) and the [tax return guide](nav:tax-return). ### Cosa fare nelle prossime due settimane
Il periodo critico va dall'8 al 20 settembre. Ecco una procedura pratica per il frontaliere che vuole gestire la situazione senza farsi cogliere impreparato.
**Passo 1: monitorare i prezzi.** Controlla ogni due giorni i listini delle stazioni di servizio in Ticino, in particolare quelle lungo la A2 e nei pressi dei valichi di Chiasso e Brogeda. Se vedi aumenti superiori a 5 centesimi al litro, valuta se fare rifornimento in Italia prima di entrare in Svizzera.
Passo 2: pianificare il pieno. Se hai un'auto con serbatoio da 50 litri, un pieno in Italia ti fa risparmiare circa 5-8 franchi rispetto alla Svizzera, a seconda del cambio. Ma considera il tempo in coda al confine: se aspetti 20 minuti a Brogeda, il risparmio si riduce. Meglio fare il pieno nelle ore meno trafficate, ad esempio la sera o il sabato mattina.
Passo 3: valutare alternative. Se la situazione peggiora, il car pooling con altri frontalieri della tua zona può ridurre i costi del 30-50%. Anche i mezzi pubblici sono un'opzione: il trasporto transfrontaliero da Como a Mendrisio o Lugano funziona, ma richiede più tempo. Per molti, l'auto resta la scelta più pratica.
Passo 4: controllare il budget. Un aumento di 10 centesimi al litro sulla benzina incide sul tuo stipendio netto. Usa il [calcolatore stipendio](nav:calculator) per verificare come le spese extra influiscono sul tuo reddito disponibile. Se hai un margine ridotto, potresti dover rivedere altre voci di spesa.
### Strumenti utili
Per chi vuole capire meglio la propria situazione finanziaria da frontaliere, il [simulatore di busta paga](nav:payslip) è uno strumento efficace. Ti aiuta a vedere quanto incide ogni spesa variabile, inclusa la benzina, sul tuo netto mensile. Se invece vuoi confrontare i costi complessivi tra vivere in Italia e lavorare in Svizzera, il [confronto costo della vita](nav:cost-of-living) ti dà una fotografia chiara.
### Scadenze da ricordare
La finestra di prelievo delle riserve chiude il 20 settembre. Dopo quella data, la Confederazione valuterà se estendere il provvedimento o se la situazione è rientrata. Nel frattempo, tieni d'occhio le comunicazioni ufficiali dell'Ufficio federale per l'approvvigionamento economico e i siti di informazione locale.
Non c'è motivo di fare scorte: la Confederazione ha garantito la disponibilità. Ma la prudenza non guasta. Se i prezzi iniziano a salire, agisci con calma: un pieno in più in Italia non risolve la situazione, ma può farti risparmiare qualche franco. E ogni franco risparmiato è un franco in più nel tuo budget mensile di frontaliere.
*Source: [tio.ch](https://www.tio.ch/newsblog/valute-e-frontiere/1949618/benzina-la-svizzera-apre-le-riserve-cosa-puo-succedere-ai-prezzi-per-i-frontalieri)*

item.title: Culture in Switzerland, record number of companies but jobs fall
item.description: In 2024, cultural enterprises in Switzerland reach 69,441, setting a record, but jobs and company size fall.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Record number of cultural enterprises in Switzerland in 2024 - Growth higher than that of the total economy - Decline in employment in the cultural sector - Decrease in average company size
## Key facts - **What**: Trend in cultural enterprises and employment - When: Year 2024 - Where: Switzerland - Who: Federal Statistical Office (FSO) - Amount: 69,441 cultural enterprises in 2024
The Swiss economic and business landscape has reached a historic milestone in the cultural sector, although accompanied by employment dynamics that differ from the past. Never before in the Confederation has such a high number of enterprises operating in this field been recorded. During 2024, companies active in the cultural sector reached 69,441, setting a record figure that highlights particularly dynamic progression. This expansion proves to be superior to the growth recorded by the Swiss economy as a whole, outlining a continuously evolving and increasingly fragmented productive fabric.
### FSO statistical data
Official details released by the Federal Statistical Office (FSO) allow for an analysis of the medium-term trend. Since 2011, the total number of cultural enterprises has marked an increase of 27%. Over the same period, the entire Swiss economy instead recorded a more modest increase, stopping at 16%. Consequently, the market share represented by cultural enterprises out of the total number of companies operating nationwide went from 9.8% recorded in the initial reference period up to 10.7% in 2024. This increase in business density reflects a profound structural transformation, which also involves professionals active in the cross-border region and local labor market dynamics. Despite the strong expansion in the number of companies, the Swiss cultural sector is facing a less favorable situation in terms of employment. During 2024, the total number of available jobs in the sector fell to 241,025, showing a 0.9% decrease compared to the previous year's data. This represents a significant trend reversal, as it is the first decline in employment levels recorded since 2020. This dynamic is explained by the very nature of recent business growth, characterized by the birth of new entities that are smaller on average than in the past.
### Business size and economic weight
Analyzing the organizational structure, it clearly emerges that cultural enterprises have progressively become smaller. In 2011, each individual company employed an average of 4.1 workers, while in 2024 this average value dropped to 3.5. A similar decline is also observed when calculating full-time equivalents per enterprise, which decreased from 2.9 to 2.3 units. This dimensional contraction is not reflected in the rest of the Swiss economy, where a similar reduction in the average size of companies has not been witnessed. Consequently, over the long term, the overall weight of culture on the country's total employment has also decreased: the sector indeed accounted for 4.7% of all jobs in 2011, a percentage that dropped to 4.2% in 2024.
### The transformation of sectors and digital media
Growth has not been uniform across the various branches of the cultural industry. Between 2023 and 2024, the largest numerical increases in companies were concentrated in the audiovisual, multimedia, and advertising sectors, as well as in activities related to cultural heritage and the performing arts. The situation in traditional markets was the opposite: the book and press sector recorded a contraction of over 3% in 2024 compared to the previous year, highlighting a deficit of 12.3% fewer businesses when compared to the pre-pandemic period of 2019. To learn more about how these changes affect the labor market and professional opportunities in the border area, you can consult the dedicated [job listings](nav:jobs) section.
## Recommended tools For an updated estimate, use the [net salary calculator](nav:calculator) and the [CHF-EUR exchange comparator](nav:exchange). The ongoing transition towards digitalization and multimedia is profoundly modifying the skills required in the Swiss cultural and economic sector. For professionals and workers operating or intending to operate between neighboring Italy and Switzerland, monitoring the evolution of these emerging sectors is essential to guide their professional choices. The progressive digitalization of advertising and audiovisual activities requires highly specialized profiles, while the contraction of traditional print media imposes a reflection on long-term employment prospects in historical publishing sectors.
### Tax and salary verifications
Labor market evolution and the creation of new micro-enterprises in the cultural sector entail the need to correctly manage one's contribution and tax position. Those who work or intend to start an independent or subordinate activity in Switzerland must pay particular attention to withholding taxes, mandatory social security contributions, and wage differences between various cantons. Accurately assessing one's net salary and the impact of current regulations allows for better planning of cross-border professional activities without surprises.

To analyze income in detail, correctly estimate the tax burden, and understand the impact of taxes on earnings derived from collaborations or employment in Switzerland, available simulation tools can be used. For a precise and updated estimate of wages and tax burdens, check your economic situation now using the [salary calculator](nav:calculator).

item.description: The labour market in Upper Piedmont has 6,470 contracts scheduled for September 2026, with more than 75% of forward contracts.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - 6,470 planned hires in Alto Piemonte for September 2026 - Over 75% of scheduled contracts will be temporary - Between 38% and 46% of companies report recruitment difficulties
## Key facts - **What**: Hiring forecasts for the month of September - When: September 2026 compared to September 2025 - Where: Biella, Novara, Verbano Cusio Ossola and Vercelli - Who: Unioncamere, Ministry of Labour and Monte Rosa Laghi Alto Piemonte Chamber of Commerce - Amount: 6,470 total scheduled contracts
The Alto Piemonte labor market is preparing to face the month of September 2026 with a total volume of 6,470 contracts planned by local businesses distributed across the provinces of Biella, Novara, Verbano Cusio Ossola and Vercelli. The data, processed by the Studies Service of the Monte Rosa Laghi Alto Piemonte Chamber of Commerce based on the monthly bulletin of the Excelsior Information System of Unioncamere and the Ministry of Labour and Social Policies, marks a minimal variation compared to the same period of the previous year, recording just 10 fewer contracts across the entire reference territory. The intercepted figure represents exactly 18.2 percent of the total hires forecast in the entire Piedmont region.
### Territorial analysis of Excelsior data
Within the individual provinces, the distribution of employment flows shows different dynamics and volumes. In Novara, the picture is growing with 3,340 expected hires, recording 100 more positions than in September 2025 and confirming itself as the main economic engine of the area. In Vercelli, expected hires stand at 1,230, maintaining the exact same volume recorded twelve months earlier. In Biella, forecasts indicate 1,120 hires, highlighting a decrease of 40 units compared to the previous September. Finally, in Verbano Cusio Ossola, planned hires are 780, marking a drop of 70 jobs compared to the data recorded in 2025. Overall, labor demand therefore remains solid but diversified, with leading sectors such as accommodation and food services, commerce and personal services continuing to express a consistent share of the overall employment requirement, while reflecting the economic and territorial specificities of each individual province examined by the Excelsior survey. A more in-depth analysis of the contractual structure highlights how the predominant typology in Upper Piedmont remains firmly tied to precariousness or, in any case, temporary flexibility. In all four provinces considered, in fact, fixed-term contracts exceed the threshold of seventy-five percent of the total hires planned for the month of September. In more detail, the province of Novara provides a share of stable contracts equal to twenty-two percent, leaving seventy-eight percent to temporary work forms. In Biella, the ratio sees twenty-five percent of stable contracts against seventy-five percent of fixed-term contracts. Even more unbalanced values are recorded in Verbano Cusio Ossola and Vercelli, where just nineteen percent of open positions offer immediate stabilization, while eighty-one percent of contracts are configured as fixed-term. This strong prevalence of temporary relationships directly affects the employment prospects of those looking for stable employment in the area.
### Critical issues in hiring and the need for experience
A second significant element emerging from chamber data concerns the persistent difficulty of companies in finding personnel with adequate requirements on the market. The percentage of companies reporting problems in finding the requested profiles varies considerably depending on the province: it goes from thirty-eight percent recorded in Vercelli up to the peak of forty-six percent detected in Verbano Cusio Ossola, while Biella stands at forty-four percent and Novara at forty percent. This difficulty clashes with a very precise request from the productive fabric: companies predominantly look for workers who already possess specific professional experience or experience gained in the same employment sector. This specific need affects sixty-three point eight percent of profiles in Verbano Cusio Ossola, sixty point one percent in Vercelli, fifty-eight point eight percent in Biella, and fifty-six point eight percent in Novara. Smaller businesses, particularly those with fewer than fifty employees, concentrate a large part of the demand, absorbing fifty-six percent of entries in Biella and Vercelli and as much as sixty-nine percent in Verbano Cusio Ossola. For those evaluating professional opportunities in the area, orienting themselves towards targeted training or consolidating vertical skills represents an obligatory step to overcome selections.

An analysis of the Excelsior survey data also offers operational insights for those looking at the cross-border labor market or evaluating professional mobility options between border regions and neighboring Swiss cantons. With demand strongly oriented towards services, trade, and catering, and a widespread requirement for personnel with specific prior experience, candidates must structure their job search by focusing on a CV that strongly highlights practical skills gained in the field. ## Living in Cucciago and working in Ticino as a cross-border commuter
Cucciago is a Swiss municipality located in the Canton of Ticino, a few kilometers from Lugano. It is a quiet and picturesque residential area, ideal for those who wish to live in a peaceful environment while still being close to the city. Thanks to its strategic location, Cucciago offers its residents the opportunity to work in Ticino and enjoy all the benefits that come with it.
### In brief - **Distance from Lugano**: 15 km - Travel time: 20 minutes by car - Cost of living: Lower than Lugano - Recommended areas: Historic center, residential neighborhood
### Cost of living The cost of living in Cucciago is generally lower than in Lugano. For example, the average price of a 3-room apartment in Cucciago is around CHF 350,000, while in Lugano it can exceed CHF 500,000. Food and service prices are also more contained in Cucciago.
### Transportation Cucciago is well connected to Lugano and other Ticino municipalities via the road and rail network. Cucciago railway station is on the Lugano-Milan line and offers direct connections to the main Swiss and Italian cities.
### Work The Canton of Ticino is an important economic region, with one of the lowest unemployment rates in Switzerland. The main industries are tourism, finance, and technology. Those who work in Ticino can enjoy a higher average salary compared to other Swiss regions.
### Regulations Cross-border commuters working in Ticino must have a Swiss work permit. The permit can be requested online on the Canton of Ticino website. The cost of the permit is CHF 100 per year.
### Operational checklist - Find accommodation in Cucciago - Register with the municipality of residence - Request a Swiss work permit - Open a Swiss bank account - Take out Swiss health insurance
### Comparison of practical scenarios #### Scenario 1: Working in Lugano and living in Cucciago - Advantages: Savings on cost of living, peaceful environment - Disadvantages: Travel time by car, possible difficulties in finding parking in Lugano
#### Scenario 2: Working and living in Cucciago - Advantages: Peaceful environment, lower cost of living - Disadvantages: Possible difficulties in finding work in Cucciago, social isolation
In conclusion, living in Cucciago and working in Ticino as a cross-border commuter can be an excellent solution for those who wish to live in a peaceful environment while still being close to the city. Thanks to its strategic location, Cucciago offers its residents the opportunity to work in Ticino and enjoy all the benefits that come with it. ## Transportation Cucciago is well connected with Lugano and the rest of Ticino thanks to an efficient bus network. The nearest train station is in Lugano, which offers connections to major Swiss and Italian cities. By car, Cucciago can be reached via the A2/A9 motorway. The travel time from Lugano is about 20 minutes, while from Milan it is about an hour and a half. For those who prefer cycling, there are several bike paths that connect Cucciago to Lugano and other locations in Ticino.
## Accommodation In Cucciago, cross-border workers can find various accommodation options, from apartments to houses. Property prices are generally lower compared to Lugano, but it is important to also consider the costs of daily transportation. For example, a 3-room apartment in Cucciago can cost around 1,500 CHF per month, while the same type of apartment in Lugano can cost over 2,500 CHF.
## Work Ticino offers various job opportunities for cross-border workers, especially in the tourism, healthcare, and finance sectors. Lugano is the main economic center of the canton and hosts numerous international companies. The average salary in Ticino is about 5,500 CHF per month, but can vary significantly depending on the sector and job position.
## Regulations Cross-border workers who work in Ticino must have a Swiss work permit. The permit can be requested by the Swiss employer or directly by the worker at the Labor Office of the canton of Ticino. The cost of the permit is 300 CHF per year. Additionally, cross-border workers must also have Swiss health insurance.
## Comparisons For a cross-border worker who works in Ticino, living in Cucciago can be a good solution to save on accommodation and transportation costs. However, it is important to also consider travel times and the availability of public transportation. For example, a cross-border worker who works in Lugano and lives in Cucciago will need to spend about 200 CHF per month on public transportation, while a cross-border worker who lives in Lugano and works in Milan will need to spend about 500 CHF per month on transportation.
## Checklist - Check the availability of accommodation in Cucciago and the related costs - Compare travel times and public transportation costs between Cucciago and Lugano - Get information on Swiss regulations regarding work permits and health insurance - Evaluate job opportunities in Ticino and the related salaries - Consider additional costs, such as expenses for bicycles or cars
## Useful tools to protect your net income To reduce FX leakage, compare [CHF-EUR exchange options](nav:exchange) and [banks for cross-border workers](nav:banks). ## Cost of living and taxes The cost of living in Cucciago is generally lower than in Lugano, but still higher than in other Italian border towns. Property prices are more affordable and the quality of life is high. As for taxes, cross-border workers are subject to withholding tax in Switzerland and must declare their income in Italy as well. It is important to be aware of the tax conventions between Switzerland and Italy to avoid double taxation.
### Cost of living In Cucciago, the cost of living is lower than in Lugano, but still higher than in other Italian border towns. Property prices are more affordable and the quality of life is high.
### Taxes Cross-border workers are subject to withholding tax in Switzerland and must declare their income in Italy as well. It is important to be aware of the tax conventions between Switzerland and Italy to avoid double taxation.
### Tax conventions The tax conventions between Switzerland and Italy are important to avoid double taxation. Switzerland signed a tax convention with Italy in 1992, which came into force in 1993. This tax convention provides that cross-border workers are subject to withholding tax in Switzerland and must declare their income in Italy as well.
### Double taxation Double taxation is a problem that can occur when working in a country different from the one in which you reside. In this case, cross-border workers who work in Ticino and reside in Italy could be subject to paying taxes in both countries. However, the tax convention between Switzerland and Italy provides that cross-border workers are subject to withholding tax in Switzerland and must declare their income in Italy as well. This means that cross-border workers should not be subject to paying taxes in both countries.
